china_race_dynamics.text: We’ve talked a lot about, this Chinese model that’s been developed for artificial intelligence and, supposedly, it’s been done cheaper and better than the United States. Color me skeptical. [...] And then second, can we acknowledge this is TikTok on steroids, right? If we’re worried about the influence of the CCP on America with TikTok, this is on steroids.
